attribution.consumerActivation: resonantLancePlayed > 0 OR shardstormPlayed > 0 OR flawlessFormPlayed > 0 OR bellOfEndingsProcs > 0 OR prismCharmProcs > 0
preflightImplications: Played > 0 implies Drawn > 0 implies Offered > 0 for every tracked card
Procs > 0 implies Owned > 0 implies Offered > 0 for every tracked relic
attribution.relicOfferSemantics: Both tracked relics are rare. Every simulator path that selects a rare relic auto-gains it, so their row-level Offered and Owned flags coincide; Procs is independently observed from RELIC_PROC events.

immutableL1Packet.reuse: Design prior only; no L1 row is re-run, pooled, rewritten or twin-matched.

authority.relationship: Successor level under the frozen ranking; not a correction, reinterpretation or rescue of existing-grammar-l0-l1-v2.

decisionRules.FAIL_CLOSED: A complete valid matrix misses a scientific gate. Close L2 only; do not retune, rescue L1, run L3, add a primitive or make a P9 claim.
decisionRules.PASS: Every preflight, win, bootstrap, natural consumer activation and zero-fault gate passes; L1 cumulative deed reachability is reported.
decisionRules.STOP: Any preflight, identity, scope, matrix, process or reliability assertion fails; no scientific result is claimed.

design.betweenSubjects: The shared seed is a CRN variance-reduction block only. L1 and L2 are divergent trajectories and are never read as twins.

estimands.activationComplementarity: For each vow and tracked activation, Pr(activated)[PC] - Pr(activated)[P] - Pr(activated)[C] + Pr(activated)[O].
estimands.deedReachability: Within L1, report per-run slain and perfects mean, nearest-rank quartiles, maximum, non-zero fraction and implied cumulative runs to thresholds 100 and 3, per vow and pooled. This is reported, not graded.
estimands.participation: Card Offered, Drawn, Played and InDeck plus relic Offered, Owned and Procs, keyed per row; per-id and consumer-disjunction rates are reported.
estimands.pooledWinComplementarity: Arithmetic mean of the Vow-0 and Vow-5 win complementarities.
estimands.winComplementarity: For each vow, Pr(win)[PC] - Pr(win)[P] - Pr(win)[C] + Pr(win)[O].

nonGoals: No L1 rescue or row reuse
No content, domain, application, presentation, fixture, map, P9 or #108 change
No Emberglass, Kindle, ward-mirror-edge, STREAM-B or Stun unbundle
No parameter rescue, protected/reserve seed, push, pull request or merge

requirements: exact L1-to-L2 pool delta at every card and relic tier
at least one L2 consumer activation and all participation implications
non-zero L1/L2 terminal-RNG divergence on shared cohort coordinates
seed-band ledger disjointness and zero protected/reserve use

question: Does the complete authored hundredShards plus untouched deed unlock set express a second Duskblade package incrementally above L1 without a new primitive?

reliability.additionalStalls: For each vow and policy cell, max(0, L2 stall count - L1 stall count), summed.

statistics.bootstrapUnit: Sample 256 whole-seed blocks with replacement; each block retains both arms, both policies and both vows. Compute cell means before PC-P-C+O; no per-row causal twin effect is formed.
statistics.interval: Two-sided 95% percentile interval using sorted indices floor(0.025B) and ceil(0.975B)-1.

thresholds.naturalActivationRule: At each vow, at least 5% of the 512 L2 rows satisfy the frozen consumer-activation disjunction.
